```{r load_library}
library(scholar)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)


```




```{r extract_citations_function}

pubid_extract_citations = function (pubid) {

html_data = rvest::read_html(paste0("https://scholar.google.com/citations?view_op=view_citation&hl=fr&user=aYTQ-WkAAAAJ&citation_for_view=aYTQ-WkAAAAJ:",pubid))



# Extract years
years <- html_data %>% 
  rvest::html_nodes('.gsc_oci_g_t') %>% 
  rvest::html_text()

if (length(years) == 0) {
  article_title <- rvest::html_elements(html_data, "#gsc_oci_title")
  if (length(article_title) == 0) {
    stop("Unexpected Google Scholar article page for ", pubid)
  }
  return(NULL)
}

# Initialize an empty citations vector
citations <- numeric(length(years))

# For each year, check if citation exists
for (i in seq_along(years)) {
  # Construct the URL parameter for the specific year
  as_yhi_param <- paste0("as_yhi=", years[i])
  
  # Find nodes with this URL parameter
  citation_nodes <- html_data %>% 
    rvest::html_nodes(xpath = paste0('//a[contains(@href, "', as_yhi_param, '")]/span[@class="gsc_oci_g_al"]'))
  
  # If the node exists, extract its value
  if (length(citation_nodes) > 0) {
    citations[i] <- as.numeric(rvest::html_text(citation_nodes[[1]]))
  }
  # Otherwise, it remains zero
}

# Create a dataframe
df <- data.frame(Year = years, Citations = citations, pubid= pubid)

return(df)}




```


```{r export_profile_and_publications}
id <- "aYTQ-WkAAAAJ"
l <- get_profile(id)
citation_history <- get_citation_history(id)
publication_table <- get_publications(id)

previous_publications <- read.csv("_data/publications_google_scholar.csv")
previous_ids <- sub(".*citation_for_view=[^:]+:", "", previous_publications$pubid)
matched_ids <- sum(previous_ids %in% publication_table$pubid)
if (!identical(as.character(l$name), "Julien Tap") ||
    length(l$total_cites) != 1 || !is.finite(l$total_cites) || l$total_cites <= 0 ||
    length(l$h_index) != 1 || !is.finite(l$h_index) || l$h_index <= 0 ||
    nrow(citation_history) == 0 ||
    matched_ids < 0.8 * length(previous_ids)) {
  stop("Google Scholar returned an incomplete profile, citation history or publication list.")
}

write.csv(citation_history, file = "_data/citation_history.csv")
yaml::write_yaml(l, file = "_data/scholar.yaml")
publication_table %>%
  arrange(desc(year)) %>%
  mutate(pubid = paste0(
    "https://scholar.google.com/citations?view_op=view_citation&hl=fr&user=",
    id, "&citation_for_view=", id, ":", pubid
  )) %>%
  select(year, title, author, journal, number, cites, pubid) %>%
  write.csv(file = "_data/publications_google_scholar.csv")
```

```{r export_citations_year_table}
# Only replace the historical series after a complete pass. A temporary
# Scholar error on article details does not prevent updating the profile.
tryCatch({
  cited_ids <- publication_table$pubid[!is.na(publication_table$cites) & publication_table$cites > 0]
  yearly <- lapply(unique(cited_ids), function(pubid) {
    Sys.sleep(5)
    pubid_extract_citations(pubid)
  })
  yearly <- bind_rows(yearly)
  if (nrow(yearly) == 0) {
    stop("No per-publication citation history received.")
  }
  write.csv(yearly, file = "_data/publications_citations_per_years.csv")
}, error = function(error) {
  message("::warning::Kept existing per-publication citation history: ", conditionMessage(error))
})
```
